name: Newsletter Footer
description: A warm paper footer built around one email capture that morphs from field to spinner to check, with kind validation, typo hints and retry.

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Called with a validated address. Resolve "already-subscribed" for known readers; reject to show the error state with Retry.

props.name: alreadySubscribed
props.description: Start in the already-subscribed state, e.g. for a signed-in reader.

props.name: successText
props.default: "You’re on the list. First issue Thursday."
props.description: Copy that morphs in word by word inside the pill on success.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Copy inside the pill when onSubscribe rejects.

props.name: note
props.description: Quiet mono line under the field when nothing else needs saying.

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }[]
props.description: Slim row of social links; an item labelled RSS gets a drawn feed icon.

props.name: legal
props.description: Legal line in the bottom row.
